issues.description: The active workflow consumes Tic_Gvkey_Cusip in CRSP and IBES preparation and a separate Tic_Gvkey_Cusip_Extened mapping in EA sampling, but no registered driver stage writes either mapping. The packaged identifiers file only proves GVKEY and symbol, not the required CUSIP/ticker mapping or the extended-map construction.

Earnings Cycle.do consumes Compustat IDs.dta on GVKEY and RDQ and uses SIC, but the registered driver has no producer for that file or proof of its date/SIC selection. COMP.FUNDQ is a local candidate with GVKEY/RDQ fields, but this assignment's bounded probe did not establish the SIC mapping or the author-named product construction.

The complete author driver requires several unprovided raw families and prepared panels (FOIA/control, Horizons, CRSP-linked data, IBES/guidance, TAQ, and RavenPack feed/mapping). Their named products, period or transformations remain unverified as recorded in the separate requirements; code source and catalog discovery do not establish a compatible local/public route.

Sample EA Final consumes Sample_EA_Extended before joining Tic_Gvkey_Cusip_Extened, but the producer and exact population/date/field contract are not established by the recorded selected workflow or a verified package route. Treat this as a specific unverified input contract; absence from one inventory or call list is not proof that no producer exists elsewhere.

The TAQ README describes 2010–2015 material, while active return and volume loops request annual files from 2006–2016 and 2009–2016 respectively. A compatible route with the full code-required years and fields has not been verified.

The driver spells the registered PreProcessing and Processing folder segments as lowercase preprocessing/processing; the frozen registered source paths use PreProcessing/Processing. Analysis matches. Preserve the selected order and check code-root/include resolution in the intended working copy; no runtime resolution test or platform assumption is made.

The sole supplied helper file is MM_Fit.m and its primary declaration is MM_Fit_V4, while the manual appendix calls MM_Fit with matching six arguments and compatible output use. The source signatures align; the remaining item is ordinary function/file-name resolution in an authorized MATLAB environment. Runtime and search-path resolution remain unverified.
